description:
Reassignment local search only (RKHMA-inspired affected-satellite refinement):
- Seed: Keep assigned observed tasks in start-time order, then append pending tasks with incoming tasks first, followed by descending reward and task ID. Evaluate the whole-satellite order through C.
- Refinement: With an existing order, test each pending task at each position, then adjacent swaps; retain strictly higher-profit feasible trials.
- Fallback: Without an existing order, repeatedly swap two tasks from a pool of at most six improving orders and retain the best feasible issued trial.
- Termination: Stop at the evaluation limit, or after one trial with fewer than two assigned tasks; return null if no feasible trial was issued. This standalone adaptation rebuilds through the evaluator and does not use source coordinator state or reproduce the original fast-refinement implementation.
